integrity: The proof is reconstructed from the source definition of \(X_c\), property \((M)\), weak nullity of the canonical basis, and the strict norm-decrease proposition for \(D_c\). No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact threshold concerns the canonical normalized one-spike family. The result proves that the total weak-limit set contains the stated closed ball but does not classify that total set.
title: A full weak-limit ball for the diagonal WMP witness on \(X_c\)
